---
title: "Check in a dog"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-02 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Find a dog when it arrives and confirm that it is cleared for today's groom.

## Applies to

Every groomer, each time a dog arrives at the shop.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile. See [GRM-01 Sign in to your
  profile](signing-in.qmd).

## Procedure

1. After you select your profile, the Check-in screen opens. The left side of
   the screen lists every dog on file. Each dog shows its owner's name and a
   label: **Cleared** in green or **Can't groom** in red.

   ![The Check-in screen](/screenshots/groomer/dog-list.png)

2. Click the **Dog or owner name** search box on the left side of the screen.

3. Type the name of the dog or the owner you are looking for. The list below
   the search box shows only the dogs that match.

   To search by the dog's name only, click **Dog** above the search box. To
   search by the owner's name only, click **Owner**. Click **Both** to search
   by either name again.

4. Click the dog in the list. The dog's card opens on the right side of the
   screen.

   ![A dog's card](/screenshots/groomer/dog-card.png)

5. Read the box at the top of the dog's card:
   - **Cleared for today's groom**, in green: the dog may be groomed.
   - **Can't groom today**, in red: the dog may not be groomed today. The
     line below names the vaccine that stops the groom, for example
     **Rabies: expired**.

6. If the dog is cleared, click **Start groom**. The box at the top of the
   card changes to **Being groomed**, with the time and your name.

## Result

The dog's card shows **Being groomed — checked in at** the current time **by**
your name, and a **Record the haircut** button.

## If something goes wrong

**Can't groom today**
: The dog's rabies vaccine has expired, or the shop has no proof of it. The
  **Start groom** button cannot be clicked. Ask the owner for a current
  rabies certificate, then click **Add paperwork** on the dog's card.

**No dog or owner by that name.**
: The dog is not on file. Check the spelling, or click **Both** to search by
  either name. If the dog is new to the shop, click **Add as a new client**.
